tools.name: subscribe_events
tools.description: Returns a protected event stream connection descriptor and replay cursor for recorded liquidation cascades and wall changes, without opening a connection.

tools.name: get_liquidation_census
tools.description: Returns aggregate liquidation price bands, venue coverage and snapshot age from the Hyperliquid position census, with no individual account rows.

tools.name: desk_read
tools.description: Returns served liquidation levels, state and reasons for one symbol from the Desk Read wall snapshot, with deprecated verdict compatibility fields.

tools.name: hk_levels
tools.description: Returns hk.levels.v1 liquidation levels from Bybit perpetual walls, with snapshot age, delay and evidence labels, using six Free coins delayed by 2 hours without a key.

tools.name: get_proof_summary
tools.description: Returns the public proof summary with sample sizes, confidence bounds and evidence links from the published scorecard and feed reconciliation record.

tools.name: get_magnet_levels_teaser
tools.description: Returns the three largest liquidation clusters per side for BTC and ETH from the public delayed wall snapshot.

tools.name: get_feed_trust_summary
tools.description: Returns venue verdicts, match rates, coverage and sample counts from the public liquidation feed reconciliation audit.

tools.name: get_liquidation_magnets
tools.description: Returns per horizon liquidation magnets and historical reach rates with sample sizes and confidence bounds from the published calibrated record.

tools.name: get_reach_stats
tools.description: Returns historical band reach rates by symbol and horizon with sample sizes and confidence intervals from the walk forward record.

tools.name: get_feed_trust
tools.description: Returns per venue verdicts, coverage and sample counts for the service's liquidation feed from its recorded reconciliation checks.

tools.name: get_accuracy_proof
tools.description: Returns the published track record with sample sizes, baselines and measurement windows from the same aggregate as the public proof page.

tools.name: get_engine_read
tools.description: Returns unvalidated directional context for a symbol and horizon from the customer engine read payload as descriptive context, not a forecast.

tools.name: get_proof_anchors
tools.description: Returns dates, content digests and chain hashes from the public daily proof anchor ledger, excluding private signatures and signing keys.

tools.name: get_decision_packet
tools.description: Returns liquidation magnets, historical reach, venue structure and feed trust from the existing evidence readers, with unavailable components labeled.

tools.name: prepare_trade
tools.description: Returns position quantity, notional and optional gross reward to risk from user supplied levels and an evidence packet, without placing or signing an order.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: Returns six Free coins without a key or the supported symbol allowlist with a key, including the applicable delay.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Creates and returns a Stripe Checkout URL for a selected prepaid data credit pack from the configured catalog, leaving payment completion to the user.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Stores the caller's service feedback and returns its receipt using the same validation and internal review queue as the public feedback form.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_proof_summary, get_feed_trust_summary, get_feed_trust, get_decision_packet · Private data: get_proof_summary, get_liquidation_magnets, get_reach_stats, get_accuracy_proof, get_proof_anchors · Public sink: get_reach_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_proof_summary, get_feed_trust_summary, get_feed_trust, get_decision_packet · Private data: get_proof_summary, get_liquidation_magnets, get_reach_stats, get_accuracy_proof, get_proof_anchors · Public sink: get_reach_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
